fw.blocked.title: TrpgMaps - Blocked by Windows Firewall
fw.blocked.text:
Windows Firewall has a rule that BLOCKS this program from receiving LAN connections.
That is why phones/tablets can't open the player page even by scanning the QR code.

Allow it now? (One administrator prompt will follow)
fw.done.text: Allowed. Connect the phone to the same Wi-Fi, then scan the code or open the player address above.
fw.repair.ok: Firewall allows it — phones/tablets can open the player page now.
fw.repair.fail: The repair didn't succeed; see app.log in the program folder.
fw.cancelled: Administrator prompt was cancelled; firewall rules were left untouched.
fw.repair.exit: The repair didn't succeed (exit code {0}); see app.log for details.
fw.error.registry: Can't open the firewall rule table
net.fw.state.allowed: Firewall allows it — phones should be able to connect
net.fw.state.fixed: Firewall fixed — phones can connect now
